mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN stock_watch_analysis_observation_identity i ON i.canonical_task_id = t.analysis_task_id LEFT JOIN stock_watch_analysis_task atask ON atask.id = t.analysis_task_id JOIN stock_watch_analysis_migration_state ms ON ms.migration_key = 'stock-watch-v6' AND ms.generation = 6 AND ms.status = 'READY'
LEFT JOIN stock_watch_analysis_task atask ON atask.id = t.analysis_task_id

t.*, atask.request_digest AS task_request_digest, atask.request_envelope_json AS task_request_envelope_json, CASE WHEN atask.purpose = 'stock-analysis-response-v6' THEN 6 WHEN atask.purpose = 'stock-analysis-response-v5' THEN 5 ELSE NULL END AS response_contract_version
AND ( i.analysis_scope = 'TECHNICAL_RUNTIME' OR (t.analysis_task_id IS NULL AND t.id <= ms.legacy_analysis_cutoff_id) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_technical_analysis (analysis_task_id, session_id, symbol, market, stock_name, analysis_date, run_slot, period_type, period_key, source_record_ids, evidence_signal_json, main_force_intent_json, main_force_intent_status, main_force_intent_warnings_json, status, stance, tone, confidence, title, conclusion, evidence_json, missing_data_json, data_snapshot_json, raw_response, prompt_hash, provider, bridge_target_id, conversation_url, context_chars_delta, error_message) VALUES (#{analysisTaskId}, #{sessionId}, #{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{analysisDate}, #{runSlot}, #{periodType}, #{periodKey}, #{sourceRecordIds}, #{evidenceSignalJson}, #{mainForceIntentJson}, #{mainForceIntentStatus}, #{mainForceIntentWarningsJson}, #{status}, #{stance}, #{tone}, #{confidence}, #{title}, #{conclusion}, #{evidenceJson}, #{missingDataJson}, #{dataSnapshotJson}, #{rawResponse}, #{promptHash}, #{provider}, #{bridgeTargetId}, #{conversationUrl}, #{contextCharsDelta}, #{errorMessage})
